meta.name: ot-cost-analysis
meta.description: Build should-cost estimates and price reasonableness analyses for Other Transaction (OT) agreements under 10 USC 4021/4022. Produces milestone- based cost analysis workbooks with cost-sharing breakdowns, per-milestone funding profiles, and price reasonableness memos. Orchestrates BLS OEWS, GSA CALC+, and GSA Per Diem skills for labor benchmarking. Trigger for: OT cost analysis, OTA cost estimate, OT price reasonableness, prototype cost estimate, OT should-cost, OT milestone pricing, OT cost-sharing analysis, OT funding profile, prototype IGCE, 10 USC 4021 cost analysis, milestone payment schedule, build an OT cost analysis. Also trigger when user has an OT project description and needs cost analysis or a performer proposed price needing reasonableness assessment. Do NOT use for FAR IGCEs (use IGCE Builder FFP, LH/T&M, or CR), OT project descriptions (use OT Project Description Builder), or grant budgets (use Grant Budget Builder).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成其他交易协议的成本估算与价格合理性分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为10 USC 4021/4022下的其他交易协议做成本分析。
copy.tagline_en: Build cost estimates and price reasonableness analyses for Other Transaction agreements.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need cost analysis for Other Transaction agreements under 10 USC 4021/4022.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据里程碑表格生成成本估算和价格合理性分析，包括成本分摊、资金安排和备忘录。它会调用 BLS、GSA 等外部数据来对比市场价格。
howto.when: 当你提供其他交易（OT）协议的项目描述或里程碑表格，并需要成本估算或价格合理性分析时触发。例如，你说“估算这个原型成本”或“检查这个报价是否合理”。

say.text: 帮我估算这个原型项目的里程碑成本。
检查这个承包商的报价是否合理。
say.note: Claude 会对比政府估算和报价，生成价格合理性备忘录。

say.text: 为这个OT协议做成本分摊分析。
say.note: Claude 会根据里程碑和成本分摊比例生成分析工作簿。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate should-cost estimates and price reasonableness analyses based on milestone tables, including cost-sharing breakdowns, funding profiles, and memos. It calls BLS, GSA, and other external data for market benchmarking.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an OT project description or milestone table and need cost estimation or price reasonableness analysis. For example, when you say 'estimate costs for this prototype' or 'check if this price is reasonable.'

say_en.text: Estimate the milestone costs for this prototype project.
Check if this contractor's proposed price is reasonable.
Perform cost-sharing analysis for this OT agreement.
